svg.aria-label: The seven non-negotiable layers of a successful 2026 public-sector grounded-assistant deployment.
svg.text: Public-sector grounded-assistant architecture: seven non-negotiable layers
1. Strict-scope retrieval -- only the vetted agency corpus, top-k with similarity floor
2. Citations always -- every claim links to a doc with source URL + last-modified + section ID
3. Refusal-by-default outside scope -- "contact this office" rather than improvise
4. Audit log of every interaction -- prompts, retrieved passages, responses, timestamps
5. Disclaimer + informed-use -- "this is a chatbot, contact a human for definitive answers"
6. Accessibility-first UI -- WCAG 2.1 AA, screen-reader, keyboard nav, plain language, multi-lingual
7. Continuous eval against public benchmark -- representative questions, regressions block deployment
FedRAMP-authorized substrate: Azure OpenAI in Az Gov, AWS Bedrock GovCloud, Vertex AI Assured WL, Claude via Bedrock
Air-gap path: open-weight (Llama / Mistral / Qwen) via vLLM or NVIDIA NIM inheriting agency ATO
